notes.title: Difficulty Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thank you all so much to all the players who played our game early! We've got A LOT of feedback, and we're still picking at what to do. Game development takes a long time!

So...to hold you over, we're announcing a small update. 

We're now adding a difficulty system! In this update, before each night, you can choose the difficulty from five modes!


Here's a run down of the different modes;


Normal 

The easiest difficulty in the game, good for those who are new to survival horror.


Hard

For those who want things a little more fast-paced


The Nightlings are slightly more aggressive



Very Hard

For those who like a little challenge


Nightlings are even more aggressive
Less toys spawn.
 


Extreme

For those who want even more of a challenge!


Nightlings are extremely aggressive
Even less toys spawn in the house
Lower stamina
NO activity icons (Essentially blind mode)



Nightmare

Only for those hardcore survival horror enthusiasts. We can't even beat this yet...


Nightlings are RELENTLESSLY aggressive
Almost NO toys
Even LOWER stamina
NO Candy bars for speed boosts & stamina regen
NO activity icons (Essentially blind mode)
Very dark environment



Nothing else to cover in this small patch, but we hope to continue to make changes accordingly to the game so it's ready for full release!


If you currently have access to the beta, you should just have to update the game.

If you don't have access to the the beta, no worries! We're still looking for streamers, content creators, and game testers to play the game early to get feedback. You can sign up here for a chance to be selected!

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1q-bjppf2wMCU3uEntXICsgIEfCtzKbKub1UE9E7jKAPkRQ/viewform?usp=dialog


Thank you all for the support, and we hope to give you some spooky fun!



Sincerely,

~ Nitro ~
Project Manager/Producer
The Nightlings Team
